tech.summary: Anthropic ne 9 November ko Claude Fable 5.2 aur Mythos 5.2 launch kiye — apne sab se capable models. Fable 5.2 ki keemat $8 input / $40 output per million tokens hai, output 30% tak tez hai, aur 1 million token context hai. Prerelease testing mein 1,000 agents ne Fermat's Last Theorem ko sirf 30 ghanton mein formalize kar diya — pehli koshish mein 11 din lage the. Benchmarks par FrontierSWE v2 mein 69.9% aur real-world freelance tasks (Remote Labor Index) mein 41.3% score kiya. Mythos wohi model hai, lekin cyber aur biology safeguards ke baghair — sirf verified organisations ke liye. Anthropic ke mutabiq us ke core codebase mein merge hone wale 90% se zyada changes ab Claude khud likhta hai.
tech.title: Claude Fable 5.2 aa gaya — Fermat ka theorem 30 ghanton mein prove kar diya

tech.summary: Bloomberg ki report ke mutabiq OpenAI ki quarterly revenue pehli dafa $10 billion se upar gayi — Q2 ke $6.7 billion se taqreeban 50% izafa, aur pichle saal se taqreeban teen guna. Annual revenue run rate ab $50 billion hai. Lekin munafa abhi door hai: operating loss $10.9 billion tak barh gaya, halanke adjusted operating margin -150% se behtar ho kar -109% ho gaya. Dilchasp baat ye hai ke Anthropic aage hai — us ki Q3 revenue $17 billion batayi ja rahi hai aur run rate $81 billion. Ye figures investors ko di gayi briefing se hain, official audited numbers nahi.
tech.title: OpenAI ki quarterly revenue pehli dafa $10bn paar — lekin loss bhi $10.9bn

tech.summary: Meta ne 9 November ko Muse Ember launch kiya — apna sab se chhota aur sab se efficient model, jo agents ke roz ke repetitive kaam ke liye bana hai: tool calls, coding subtasks, routing, extraction aur lambi documents parhna. Keemat sirf $0.10 input / $0.50 output per million tokens, 1M-token context aur 512K output. Artificial Analysis ke index par Ember ka score 36 hai — Claude Haiku 5.5 ke barabar — lekin cost per task taqreeban aik tihai ($0.14 vs $0.41). Model ab Meta Model API aur Muse Code par `muse-ember-1.0` ke tor par live hai, aur ye pehla model hai jo Muse Wonder Full se train kiya gaya.
tech.title: Meta ka Muse Ember — Haiku jitna smart, aik tihai keemat par

tech.summary: ElevenLabs ne 11 November ko apne New York Summit mein 13 naye products aur upgrades ka package dikhaya — voice tool se enterprise AI platform ki taraf qadam. Businesses ab apne live deployment data se models ko fine-tune karwa sakenge, ElevenAgents mein Memory aur Routines aayengi, aur naya ElevenAI app meetings sun kar notes, summaries aur action items banayega — free early access khul gayi hai. NVIDIA ke saath partnership bhi barhi: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL ElevenAgents mein aur 15 MW Vera Rubin compute. CEO Mati Staniszewski ke mutabiq conversational agents chand saalon mein 'har enterprise ke liye critical infrastructure' ban jayenge.
tech.title: ElevenLabs ab sirf voice nahi — ElevenAI app aur apne models ki fine-tuning

tech.summary: AI cloud company CoreWeave ne Q3 mein $3.66 billion revenue report ki — pichle saal se 168% zyada aur analysts ke $3.55 billion ke estimate se upar. Company ne 2026 ka revenue forecast barha kar $13–13.3 billion kar diya aur backlog $132.5 billion tak pahunch gaya. Shares ne after-hours mein taqreeban 7% rally ki. Lekin doosri taraf net loss $709 million tak barh gaya, qarz taqreeban $47 billion hai, aur 2026 ka capex $37–39 billion hoga. CEO ke mutabiq customers se $9 billion prepayments aane wale teen mahinon mein milenge — AI demand asal hai, sawal ye hai ke is ki keemat kaun dega.
tech.title: CoreWeave ki revenue 168% barhi — $13bn ka naya forecast, lekin qarz $47bn

tech.summary: Teen Republican House committee chairs ne Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang ko 4 November ke khat mein 18 November ko closed-door briefing ke liye bulaya — Megaspeed executive Alice Huang se un ke rabtay aur Nvidia ke anti-espionage protocols par. US intelligence ke mutabiq Alice Huang Beijing ko maloomat de rahi thi; Megaspeed par China ko pabandi wale AI chips pohanchane ka shuba hai. Huang ko 11 November tak date accept karni thi ya koi aur date deni thi — ABC News ke mutabiq Tuesday tak jawab nahi aaya tha, aur committee chairman Brian Mast ne kaha ke zaroorat pari to subpoena bhi de sakte hain. Nvidia ka board apni alag investigation bhi chala raha hai; 17 November ko earnings call hai. Abhi tak kisi par koi ilzaam sabit nahi hua.
tech.title: Nvidia ke Jensen Huang ko Congress ki briefing — deadline guzar gayi, subpoena ki dhamki

pakistan.summary: Kohat ke Darabukach ilaqe mein budh ko police party par hamle mein 10 police ahalkar shaheed ho gaye, jin mein DSP Haidar Zaman aur Sub-Inspector Mukhtiar bhi shamil hain — 12 zakhmi hue. KP Police ke mutabiq team ghair-qanooni gold mining ke khilaf operation se wapas aa rahi thi jab Fitna al-Khawarij ne hamla kiya; jawab mein 18 hamla-awar halak hue. Hamle ki zimmedari Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan ne qabool ki. Wazir-e-Azam Shehbaz Sharif ne shaheedon ko khiraj-e-aqeedat pesh kiya. Ye hamla aik din baad hua jab Kohat DC ne gold mining ilaqon mein excavators par 60 din ki pabandi lagayi thi. KP mein governor's rule aur emergency 11 October se nafiz hai.
pakistan.title: Kohat mein hamla — 10 police shaheed, 18 dehshatgard halak

pakistan.summary: Wazir-e-Azam Shehbaz Sharif ne Antalya mein COP31 par kaha ke Pakistan ne sirf do saalon mein taqreeban 22 gigawatts rooftop solar capacity laga li hai — 'aam shehriyon ka khamosh inqilab' jo sasti bijli chahte hain. Unhon ne '35 by 35' Global Electrification Pledge ki himayat ki aur kaha ke Pakistan ko 2035 tak low-carbon power ke liye $138 billion aur koyla ko solar se badalne ke liye mazeed $50 billion chahiye. Clean sources ab energy mix ka taqreeban 55% hain, Chashma-5 se 1,200MW mazeed milega, aur is saal bikne wali har 10 mein se aik se zyada motorcycle electric thi. Unhon ne Erdogan, Guterres aur Iran aur Kuwait ke rehnumaon se bhi mulaqatein ki.
pakistan.title: COP31 par Shehbaz: Pakistan ne 2 saal mein 22GW rooftop solar laga liya

pakistan.summary: India ne Maldives ko Dhaka mein 1-0 se hara kar Pakistan ki SAFF Championship semi-final ki jagah pakki kar di. Suhail Ahmad Bhat ne 38th minute mein penalty se faisla-kun goal kiya. India group B mein 6 points ke saath pehle aur Pakistan 3 points ke saath doosre number par raha — Pakistan ne 5 goals kiye aur 3 khaye. Semi-final haftay, 14 November ko hoga, jahan Pakistan ka muqabla Group A ke winner (Bangladesh ya Sri Lanka) se hoga. Final 17 November ko hai.
pakistan.title: Pakistan SAFF semi-final mein — India ne Maldives ko 1-0 se hara diya

pakistan.summary: Pakistan Stock Exchange par budh ko KSE-100 index ne intraday 180,769 tak ja kar 180,000 ki satah paar ki — ye level 18 August ke baad pehli dafa dekha gaya — lekin phir heavyweight stocks mein profit-taking ne gains mita diye aur index 251 points gir kar 179,084 par band hua. Is se pehle mangal ko index ne 5,449 points ki zabardast rally ki thi. Cement stocks mein tezi rahi, Punjab cement royalty case ke faisle ki umeed par. Volume 1.24 billion shares aur traded value Rs41.7 billion rahi.
pakistan.title: PSX ne 180,000 paar kiya — phir profit-taking ne 251 points gira diye

pakistan.summary: Pakistan Meteorological Department ne mulk ke balai hissay mein 12 se 14 November tak barish, aandhi aur paharon par barf-bari ki peshgoi ki hai. Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Punjab, Islamabad, Azad Kashmir aur Gilgit-Baltistan mein tez barish aur kahin-kahin ole bhi par sakte hain, jab ke din ka darja-e-hararat 2–4 degree girne ka imkaan hai. Sindh aur Balochistan ke aksar ilaqon mein mausam khushk rahega. Met Office ne kashtkaron aur pahari ilaqon ke safar karne walon ko ehtiyat ki hidayat ki hai — spell ke baad maidani ilaqon mein dhund bhi par sakti hai.
pakistan.title: Uttari ilaqon mein barish aur barf — 14 November tak mausam kharab

pakistan.summary: Senate Chairman Syed Yousaf Raza Gillani ne kaha hai ke student unions ki bahali aur mazboot local government system mulk mein leadership ke buhran ka hal hai. Islamabad mein UNICEF ke workshop se khitab karte hue unhon ne kaha ke grassroots par leadership ki nurseries 'so gayi hain' aur unhein jagana zaroori hai. Unhon ne apni siyasi safar ki misaal di — local level se shuru kar ke wazir-e-azam bane — aur kaha ke har rupee ka hisab hona chahiye: budget sirf manzoor karna kaafi nahi, paisa logon tak pohanchna chahiye.
pakistan.title: Gillani ka mutalba — student unions bahal hon, local government mazboot ho
